segments.title: Cold Open & Network Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour sign-on as executive producer; Case Blackwell prepares for the Friday broadcast.

segments.title: Harvard Foreign Student Ban Blocked & Golden Dome Missile Defense
segments.notes: Case and Rick debate a federal judge blocking Trump's Harvard international student enrollment ban; Trump announces $175B Golden Dome space-based missile defense system targeting three-year deployment.

segments.title: Peter Gibbon's 'Big Hat' Conspiracy
segments.notes: News stowaway Peter Gibbon hijacks the feed with purported hidden-camera footage alleging Case rigged his 'Big Hat' idea-pulling stream; demands Case use his mailed-in soup-eating idea.

segments.title: AI Slop Showcase: OpenAI/Johnny Ive Deal & Veo 3 Generations
segments.notes: Case and Rick react to OpenAI's $6.5B acquisition of Johnny Ive's IO Products for AI hardware; watch Sam Altman/Ive promotional video; screen AI-generated video clips including BIN deepfakes and brain-rot animal trailers.

segments.title: DJ C4 Celtic Dubstep Production: 'Rockin' in the Green Screen'
segments.notes: Case's second cousin DJ C4 debuts his music-production segment with ghost writer and artist Rory Blarneystone; chaotic Pro Tools session yields a completed Irish-themed dubstep/trap track after multiple vocal takes and ad-lib passes.

segments.title: Wrap-Up & Pre-Expo Raid Announcement
segments.notes: Case closes the broadcast, announces Sunday OTK stream with Bruce Green, exports vocal stems to Discord, and ends on a pre-Expo raid for Bruce Green.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored the Friday broadcast; debated Harvard ruling and Golden Dome; endured Peter Gibbon's conspiracy; oversaw DJ C4 music segment; voice blown out from screaming during production.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold-open sign-on; bantered about Memorial Day and veterinarian 'valor'; managed DJ C4 segment redemption.

characters.name: Rick
characters.notes: correspondent. Co-anchored news desk; possessed by Hype Train mid-segment; debated Golden Dome feasibility; reacted to AI slop showcase.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: musical interruption. Possessed Rick for a freestyle rap about Celtic beats and 'chelales'; derailed into family-to-scatological narrative before Rick regained control.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Hijacked broadcast with 'Big Hat' conspiracy video alleging Case rigged his idea-pulling stream; demanded credit for mailed-in soup idea.

characters.name: DJ C4
characters.notes: music producer. Debuted music-production segment as Case's second cousin; recent college grad with Halliburton-funded studio; struggled with Pro Tools but completed Celtic dubstep track.

characters.name: Ghost Writer
characters.notes: ghost writer. Free-range ghost co-writing lyrics with DJ C4; claims 200 years of ghostwriting; contributed 'chorus' ad-lib that locked the song.

characters.name: Rory Blarneystone
characters.notes: artist. Self-proclaimed pro vocalist; recorded multiple takes for 'Rockin' in the Green Screen'; delivered high-energy ad-libs despite blown-out vocals.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Brief call-in confirming half-day and dinner plans; appeared on-camera during DJ C4 session; left for dinner with Elena.

lore_notes.fact: Confirmed as Case Blackwell's second cousin; recently graduated college with classic literature degree; owns production studio funded by father (Halliburton owner).
Identifies as a 'free-range ghost' who chooses to inhabit the ghost writer room; claims 200 years of ghostwriting experience; not confined like other studio ghosts.
Has a 'spine thing' preventing handshakes; voice repeatedly blows out from screaming during music production but recovers within an hour.
Claims to be a professional artist who can 'nail it in one shot'; known for ad-libs; difficult to work with but delivers high-energy performances.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell's Friday broadcast covered a federal judge blocking Trump's Harvard foreign-student ban and the announced $175B Golden Dome missile defense shield. News stowaway Peter Gibbon interrupted with a conspiracy alleging Case rigged his 'Big Hat' idea stream. The show pivoted to an AI slop showcase of OpenAI's Johnny Ive deal and Veo 3 generations, then devoted the final ninety minutes to DJ C4's debut music-production segment where Case's second cousin, a ghost writer, and artist Rory Blarneystone chaotically produced a Celtic dubstep track titled 'Rockin' in the Green Screen'.
